williams_context.lead_in_attribution: Williams prints the list as a statement Dr. Isaac Watts wrote on a blank leaf at the beginning of the last volume of his own copy of the Exposition (OCR, leaf n426: "Dr. Watts, in his copy of the Exposition, upon a blank leaf at the beginning of the last volume," ... "wrote the following statement: — \"The Reverend Mr. Matthew Henry before his death had made some small\" ...). The statement ends "By these assistances the ministers whose names are here written, have endeavoured to complete this work in the style and method of the author: viz." and the list follows on leaf n427.
williams_context.williams_cites: Footnote on the list: "Protestant Dissenters' Magazine, vol. iv. p. 472." (where Watts's note was printed; not fetched).
footnotes_n427: (marker on the Romans line) "The Exposition on the Romans, begun by Henry, and finished by Dr. Evans, is the best I ever saw." Dr. Doddridge's Works, vol. 3, p. 474.
(marker on the James line) "This should be Dr. S. Wright."

(marker on the 1 Peter line) "The editors of the 4to edition, ut supra, assign the 1 Peter to Mr. Z. Marriot; on what evidence does not appear. Mr. Stedman also varies from Dr. Watts, without any explanatory remark, by attributing 1 Peter to Mr. Hill, and 2 Peter to 'Mr. Merril, of Hampstead.' Letters to a Young Clergyman, vol. i. p. 174." (OCR read; 'ut mpra', 'attributinsr', 'vol. j.' corrected)

(marker on the 1, 2, and 3 John line) "In the quarto edition of the Exposition, ut supra, it is by mistake, 'Mr. T. Reynolds.' Dr. Watts has noticed this 'Comment on the Three Epistles,' in his Preface to Mr. Reynolds's Practical Discourse of Reconciliation between God and Man, p. 6. 8vo. 1729."

notes: All 22 rows (21 books, with 1, 2 and 3 John split) are named in at least two dated printed sources read on 2026-11-14. Nothing was filled from memory.; Quotes are readings of the archive.org OCR text layer, not of the page images, which could not be viewed from this session (archive.org is reachable only through the web-fetch tool). The 'quote' field normalises spacing and corrects obvious OCR misreadings (for example '3Ir.' to 'Mr.'); the exact OCR string is kept in 'ocr_raw'. Check the image at the given leaf before quoting to a reader.; Leaf numbers are archive.org's 0-based scan positions (the /page/nX URLs), derived from the OCR page index; the full-text search numbers the same pages one higher (Williams list: 430; Philadelphia Romans heading: 293). Printed page numbers were not legible in the OCR. Blue Letter Bible cites this list as Williams, Memoirs, 8vo, p. 308, which is probably another edition (the 1828 first edition was not found on archive.org).; In the 1829 London OCR the lines for Philippians/Colossians, 1 and 2 Thessalonians, 1 Timothy and Titus are garbled (the books are printed in braced pairs); for 1 and 2 Thessalonians, 1 Timothy and Titus the primary quote is therefore the 1830 Boston printing of the same list, whose names column reads cleanly in order: Evans, Browne, Mayo, Bayes, Rosewell, Harris, Daniel Mayo, Atkinson, Smith, Tong, Wright, Merrill, Hill, Reynolds of Shrewsbury, Billingsley, Tong.; CONFLICT 1 Peter: Watts's list in Williams (1829, 1830) has 'Mr. Zech. Merrill'; the Burder and Hughes edition (Philadelphia 1828) heading has 'Completed by Mr. Z. Marriot.' Williams says the quarto editors give Marriot 'on what evidence does not appear', and that Stedman gives 1 Peter to Hill and 2 Peter to 'Mr. Merril, of Hampstead'. Treat Merrill as Watts's attribution and say the sources differ.; CONFLICT 1-3 John: Watts's list has 'Mr. John Reynolds, of Shrewsbury'; the 1828 headings have 'Mr. T. Reynolds'. Williams calls 'T. Reynolds' a mistake and cites Watts's preface to Reynolds's Practical Discourse of Reconciliation (1729), which mentions Reynolds's 'Comment on the Three Epistles'.; CONFLICT James: Watts's list as Williams prints it reads 'Mr William Wright', with Williams's footnote 'This should be Dr. S. Wright.'; the 1830 Boston printing also reads 'Mr. William Wright.' without (per the OCR) the footnote; the 1828 heading reads 'Completed, by Dr. S. Wright.' None of these three sources prints the first name 'Samuel'; the writer field therefore says 'S. Wright'.; 2 Corinthians: the 1830 Boston OCR reads 'Mr. David Mayo.' for 2 Corinthians but 'Mr. Daniel Mayo.' for 1 and 2 Thessalonians; the 1829 London reads 'Daniel' (OCR ']\Ir Daniel ;>Iavo.'), and 1828 has 'Mr. D. Mayo.'. Probably a Boston misprint or OCR slip; Daniel Mayo is the reading of the other two.; Spelling variants: 'Simon Browne' (Williams) / 'Simon Brown' (1828); 'Samuel Rosewell' (Williams) / 'Roswell' (1828); 'Revelations' (Williams list heading) / 'Revelation' (1828).; Only the first name or initial is printed for Merrill ('Zech.'); 'Zechariah' is not in these sources.; The 1828 Philadelphia title page (leaf n6) prints no date; 1828 is from the archive.org catalogue. The 1853 New York (Carter) vol. 6 (archive.org expositionofoldn0006henr) has the same style of heading ('Completed, by Mr. J. Billingsley.' for Jude, search page 876), so the headings carried into later American printings.; Not found: a scan of the 1721 first printing of vol. 6, and the Protestant Dissenters' Magazine vol. iv (1797) p. 472 that Williams cites. The CCEL online text prints the same list but credits it to Williams, so it is not an independent source.
